train_model_disambiguation: train a GPT-2 or BERT based disambiguation model for ambiguous candidate identification using train, dev, devtest, and teststd files
evaluate_model_predictions: evaluate the model on a dataset and return recall, precision, and F1 scores for ambiguous candidate predictions
save_model_predictions_json: save model predictions to a JSON file organized by dialog_id with turn-level disambiguation candidate lists
configure_visual_feature_loader: configure a visual feature loader with a specified path and feature size for multimodal input to the model
run_cli_training_pipeline: run the CLI training pipeline with argparse arguments for backbone, batch size, learning rate, and number of epochs
